mutation FlxThemeSettingsSave($input: FlxThemeSettingsSaveInput!) {
  flxThemeSettingsSave(input: $input) {
    settings {
      ...FlxThemeSettingsFields
    }
    errors {
      code
      message
      field
    }
  }
}

fragment FlxThemeSettingsFields on FlxThemeSettings {
  visibility
  comingSoonTitle
  comingSoonText
  storeNoticeTitle
  storeNoticeText
  storeNoticeTitleDefault
  storeNoticeTextDefault
  contactEmail
  siteType
  pattern
  tableHead
  newsIntro
  darkMode
  animations
  pagination
  activeCard
  activeCampaign
  cookieEnabled
  cookieTitle
  cookieText
  cookieAccept
  cookieReject
  cookieMore
  cookiePage
  cookiePosition
  cookieRevision
  ga4Id
  gaMode
  consentScripts
  bankHolder
  bankIban
  bankInUse
  woocommerceActive
  activeCardAvailable
  canEditScripts
  presetsUrl
  campaigns {
    databaseId
    title
  }
}
